136:t_016:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No enemy can stand against the $$拡散構造相転移砲$$ and me at its controls...!」

136:t_016:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Considering your results, I'll agree with you this time.」

136:t_017:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Bring it on, $$サイデリアル$$! No matter how many you send, $$紅蓮$$ and I will shoot them down!」

136:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're even more confident than usual, $$カレン$$.」

136:t_017:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course I am! This is my hometown!」

136:t_018:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「I've confirmed the enemy force's destruction!」

136:t_018:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You've got plenty of spirit, $$スザク$$.」

136:t_018:2.en:
$$スザク$$
(I once obliterated this city with $$フレイヤ$$...)

136:t_018:3.en:
$$スザク$$
(I'll atone for that now...! I won't let this city burn again!)

136:t_019:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've confirmed that the enemy troops have fallen silent.」

136:t_019:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「The $$ハイパー・メガ粒子砲$$ lives up to its reputation. It deserves to be the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s signature weapon.」

136:t_019:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll keep up this momentum! We'll drive $$サイデリアル$$ back in one push!」

136:t_020:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You were moths to a flame, $$サイデリアル$$.」

136:t_020:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have a whole lineup of machines that show their true worth against large groups of enemies.」

136:t_021:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-Impossible...! I cannot accept this outcome!」

136:t_021:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Remember this, $c, $$ゼロ$$! I'll repay this humiliation ten thousand times over!」

136:t_022:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What's this about not accepting it? The outcome was decided the moment you wandered out here.」

136:t_022:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But men like him are persistent. He will surely attack us again.」

136:t_022:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I'll show him the difference in our abilities as often as it takes, until even his brain can grasp it.」

136:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$ゼロ$$! If only you weren't here...!」

136:t_100:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Soldiers won't follow a commander fighting over a personal grudge.」

136:t_100:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Shut up! I'll stop your insolent mouth this instant!」

136:t_100:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your mask has slipped, $$ギルター$$. Driven by your hatred of me, you resort to brute force. You're just a petty villain with a little cunning.」

136:t_100:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Shut up! Shut uuup! You bastard!!」

136:t_100:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Come at me if you're prepared to be shot! I'll strike you down myself!」

136:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This would never have happened if you hadn't shown up then!」

136:t_101:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「By that logic, all you had to do was refrain from invading Earth.」

136:t_101:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of talking to you any longer. Disappear.」

136:t_102:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Too bad, small fry! Looks like you were no match for $$ゼロ$$!」

136:t_102:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Shut up! The battle isn't over yet!」

136:t_102:2.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I pity the soldiers serving an incompetent commander who doesn't even know when to retreat!」

136:t_102:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then let's finish him off fast so he can't do any more damage!」

136:t_103:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「The outcome is already decided. If you don't want needless casualties, please withdraw your troops.」

136:t_103:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You intend to show mercy to me... to $$ギルター・ベローネ$$?!」

136:t_103:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「That's not it. We simply want to avoid making $$トウキョウ$$ a battlefield as much as possible.」

136:t_103:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then as punishment for insulting me, I'll reduce this city to ashes!」

136:t_103:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「If that's what you intend, we'll fight you to the very end, to cut off the source of this conflict!」

136:t_104:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You must be the unit commander! I'll follow standard tactics and crush you!」

136:t_104:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Their commander can't even gauge the strength of his opponents...!」

136:t_104:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You...! Are you mocking me?!」

136:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「After seeing a man who served as both leader and pilot, I certainly feel inclined to!」

136:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we beat this man, the battle will be decided!」

136:t_105:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can a brat who confuses courage with recklessness really stand against me?!」

136:t_105:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You don't seem to know what happens on the battlefield to someone who assumes he's better than his opponent!」

136:t_106:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I don't like it. A pure white machine doesn't belong on my battlefield.」

136:t_106:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「It might be amusing to stain it red with your blood and the flames of its explosion.」

136:t_106:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're so overbearing...! Listening to you is anything but pleasant!」

136:t_106:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「With a man like this in command, we have an opening to exploit!」

136:t_107:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You're the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$! Defeating you will make a fine prize to bring back!」

136:t_107:1.en:
$n
「I didn't acquire the $$スフィア$$ to give you something to take credit for!」

136:t_107:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then learn your place! An ordinary fool like you has no right to possess a $$スフィア$$!」

136:t_107:3.en:
$n
「An ordinary fool, huh... That's a title better suited to an incompetent commander.」

136:t_107:5.en:
$n
「So many people gave me this power! The words of someone like you won't shake me!」

136:t_108:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If only you hadn't come...!」

136:t_108:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「This is my hometown! You're the ones who shouldn't have come here!」

136:t_108:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't forgive you! If you try to burn this country... this city we've finally rebuilt, you'll have to face me!」

136:t_108:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「I am $$紅月カレン$$! I'm one of the $$黒の騎士団$$ who protect the peace!!」
